close-reopen-revival.text: What ships, and the accepted design

What ships today is ckeri close by the current keys, documented on Close your identity checkpoint. The accepted design (D-036 to D-040) is the reap by the next keys and the revival from the retained output. Play Alice leaves and Alice revives her parked identity and the registry simulation. There is no withdraw. Conviction is the only terminal state.

Alice leaves. That is the reap, the only close there is, and not a current-key close: a witnessed rotation by the next keys whose signed message names the payee of the premium (the fee for landing a rotation) and the refund address. The premium goes to that payee when the pool of advance funds covers it; otherwise the payee is paid nothing — an unpaid close is still a close. The remaining bonds and pool go to the refund address. The parked output retains its token, minimum ADA and that key state. The registry key stays active.

A relayer with the public rotation cannot reap: the payee and the address are one message the new keys sign. Mallory holding only the stolen current keys cannot reap. Mallory holding the next keys can: that is control (pre-rotation).
Parked is not gone. Its retained output remains on chain, but consumers refuse it. Top-up, poison (the owner's own lock), freeze, rotate, register-again are all refused. Two ways out:

Revival. A witnessed rotation later than the parked key state, consuming that retained output with fresh bonds, a first pool, a refund address chosen by whoever pays, born juvenile (younger than the window W a consumer waits out). Replaying the close's own rotation is refused.

Conviction. A duplicity proof against the parked key state. The proof consumes the retained output into pending custody. No bonds or pool remain to pay. Only the associated Registry fold consumes that request, burns the token and permanently retires the registry key.
Coming back, the checkpoint is consumable only after the juvenility window W. Registering the same AID again is refused forever: the token is minted once.
The close page is the V1 command that ships on preprod. Do not read it as the accepted design.
